name: Renzo
description:
Renzo Finance is a blockchain technology company building the tools and infrastructure needed to make professional-grade yield strategies accessible onchain.

Renzo takes strategies that have traditionally required professional trading desks and complex infrastructure and makes them easier to access and automate. The strategies operate directly inside accounts users already own and control. Users keep control of their assets and positions, and Renzo never pools or takes custody of their funds.

The debut product is Renzo Basis, a delta-neutral strategy running on Hyperliquid. It buys spot and shorts an equal-sized perpetual on the same asset, so price moves on the two legs offset each other. Yield comes from the funding rate that leveraged longs pay shorts, settled hourly. BTC and HYPE are the first markets, with additional markets added over time.
